summary_en: Financial Partners Group authorized acquisition of up to 1.2 million shares (1.4% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 2 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice on Resolution of Matters Concerning Treasury Share Acquisition
translation_en_brief: On October 29, 2026, the Board of Directors of Financial Partners Group Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime: 7148) resolved to acquire its own shares under the authority granted by the Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 1.2 million shares, representing 1.4% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum expenditure of 2.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027, or earlier if either the share or yen limit is reached. The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
